title: Closure theorem for integer multiplicity cycles of bounded mass (Simon 6.8.2 in the case ∂T_j = 0, Remark 6.4)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n < P. Let T_j (j ∈ ℕ) and T be currents in 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) such that every T_j is integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity), ∂T_j = 0 for every j (contract BoundaryVanishes; vacuous for n = 0), sup_j M(T_j) < ∞ (M = mass = M_{ℝ^P}), and T_j ⇀ T in ℝ^P (WeaklyConvergesOn). Then T is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), n < P → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ j, BoundaryVanishes (Ts j)) → ⨆ j, (Ts j).mass < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
